video_case_profile.timestamp_policy: Each temporal pair is introduced at its midpoint timestamp, rounded to one decimal place exactly as prepare_video_npu_inputs.py formats it.
video_case_profile.sampling_policy: Retain candidate temporal-pair positions 0, 2, and 3 from the nearest-integer nominal 4 fps sequence. This preserves the first and last event states while keeping the prompt at or below the AR128/CL512 prefill-safe ceiling and every pair disjoint from vision-calibration frames.
video_case_profile.runtime_limit_basis: Pinned GenieX v0.3.16 corrupts the prefill-to-decode KV transition above CL-AR = 384 prompt tokens. Equivalent three-pair prompts at 320 and 316 tokens decode coherently; the former four-pair prompts at 413 and 408 tokens do not.
